grading_basis: Grade answer content against the unchanged requested material facts, independently of support labels. Correct: all requested facts supplied; Partial: requested facts omitted or unresolved without material contradiction; Incorrect: material contradiction. Equivalent wording accepted; no facts borrowed from other answers.

No material contradiction.
